Man apprehended in Noida for gold chain snatching, Bengaluru links probed

Authorities in Noida have apprehended an individual in connection with the snatching of a gold chain from a woman. Separately, reports indicate the same individual may have links to a gold smuggling syndicate operating in Bengaluru. Investigations are ongoing into both incidents.
